Scranton, Pennsylvania · Barbershop

Cuts, shaves, and beard work on South Main.

JAC Barber Shop is a black-walled, wood-floored shop at 317 S Main Ave, open seven days a week. Haircuts, hot towel shaves, head shaves, and beard trims. Call or message to get in the chair.

Open 7 days Mon to Sat 9 to 7 · Sun 9 to 2 317 S Main Ave
